domainFacts: CRITICAL: Scripts use non-schema column names for scan runs (fsi_scanrunid, fsi_scantimestamp, fsi_totalagents, fsi_overallstatus). Schema defines fsi_scanid, fsi_scanstartedat, fsi_scancompletedat, fsi_agentsscanned. Full alignment is required before deployment.
Zone option set uses values 100000000-100000003 (not 0/1/2). Scripts must convert zone integers to the correct option set values before Dataverse writes.
Violation records require fsi_violationid and fsi_violationstatus (Required). Scripts currently omit these required columns.
Teams incoming webhooks are deprecated. Adaptive card template references to incoming webhooks should be replaced with Power Automate Workflows or Graph Teams channel posting.
